at: He sits on a hill like a king
alt: Little Star sits a hill; Haemosu still flies the remaining sun above him
scene: INTRO-CARD WEBTOON two-shot, faces LARGE in the central band. PRIMORDIAL ink-brush aura: splashed sumi at the frame edges, dry-brush flying-white, paper grain. DAY. Worm’s-eye from the hill. ONE DEVICE: a dark hill pyramid, one gold sun-disc. LEFT of the sheet = Little Star, sitting one knee up, petty grin, white po, maroon-gold collar, maroon sash, silver-grey hair with a wine-red streak — REDRAW as webtoon, the sheet is a photograph so copy clothes and hair ONLY, never pores. SECOND = Haemosu in a gold chariot in the upper third, LONG white hair streaming, white open po, easy grin, looking down at the hill — FACE from the illustrated Haemosu, KEEP the long tail. One of each. Never clone. Never jougwan. #C94040 on Little Star’s sash; #f0b429 as the sun-disc key, not a body halo. No photoreal landscape.

at: Four of them, if you're counting
alt: All four: Little Star and Haemosu on the warm side, Big Star and Haewonmek on the dark road

SHEET left to right: LEFT Little Star, SECOND Haemosu, THIRD Big Star, FOURTH Haewonmek. One of each. NEVER clone Haemosu onto Haewonmek.
